verdict.rationale: Channel3 is an agentic-commerce catalog layer between agents and merchants, so merchant-side controls over which agents can reach a catalog and checkout are a fair question for it. The evidence pack documents only developer- and agent-facing features: search, product lookup, MCP and UCP connectivity, pricing, and affiliate attribution. Nothing shows merchants can rate-limit, allow, or deny specific agents or agent platforms.

support.subject: As a merchant, I can rate-limit, allow, or deny specific agents and agent platforms accessing my catalog and checkout
